29.03.2023 AO No. 2 of 2023
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Prabhat Pande, Advocate, for 
the appellant.
Admit the Appeal.
Summon the LCR.
Issue notices to the respondents.
Steps to be taken by the appellant 
within a period of one week from today.
List thereafter.
Subject to the condition the 
appellant deposits the entire awarded 
amount before the learned Motor Accident 
Claims Tribunal/2nd Additional District Judge, 
Nainital, so far it is levied against the 
appellant i.e. 50 per cent of the total 
awarded amount, after the adjustment of 
the statutory deposits made by the 
appellant; within a period of six weeks from 
today, the execution of the impugned award 
dated 28.09.2022, passed in MACP No. 171 
of 2017, Smt. Gopa Datt Chatterji and 
another Vs. Shri Rakesh Kumar Sahu and 
others, would be kept in abeyance.
Stay Application No. IA/1/2023 
stands disposed of accordingly.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
